name: Ohio Youth & Government (YMCA model government)
org: Ohio Alliance of YMCAs, Ohio Youth & Government
city: Columbus, OH (State Assembly), delegations across Ohio
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. Prepare in the fall. Then take part in a student-run model government at the spring State Assembly in Columbus. High school roles include legislator, court, lobbyist and media.
who_can_apply: Middle school (6th to 8th) and high school (9th to 12th) students. You join through a local delegation run by a school or YMCA.
pay_detail: Registration fee amount is not stated on the pages read. A $25 late fee applied last year. Financial aid pages exist for middle and high school.
duration: Fall prep, then a 3-day State Assembly in spring
deadline_text: Last cycle: State Assembly February 12 to 14, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency Columbus. Registration closed November 28, 2025, with late registration December 1 to 10, 2025. 2027 dates are not posted on the page read.
how_to_apply: Join or start a delegation at your school or YMCA in the fall. New delegations can email yg@ohioymcas.org or call (614) 407-4819. Students and advisors register on the State Assembly registration page.
notes: Not a job. The registration page still showed the 2026 assembly dates, so check it for the 2027 dates.
